text:
To find the total time in minutes, convert the duration of each movie to minutes and add them together:

- First movie: $1\text{ hour } 30\text{ minutes} = 60 + 30 = 90\text{ minutes}$
- Second movie: $2\text{ hours } 5\text{ minutes} = (2 \times 60) + 5 = 125\text{ minutes}$

Total time: $90 + 125 = 215\text{ minutes}$

ANSWER: 215
